name: debug_trace_imports
description: ltrace-like API trace for one module (default eboot.bin) of the attached process: resolves PLT imports (Orbis PT_SCE_DYNLIBDATA / standard PT_DYNAMIC JMPREL -> GOT -> NID-demangled symbol; from elf_artifact or the in-memory ELF, else unnamed lazy PLT stubs), breakpoints the PLT stubs (or bound targets) of the filtered imports, resumes, and records symbol, caller, SysV args (+ optional strings), thread and time per call. Bounded by timeout, max_events and the breakpoint budget; always halts and clears its breakpoints. Saves a JSONL trace artifact. All-stop: every hit pauses all threads.

module.description: Module name (exact or substring); default eboot.bin

filter.description: Case-insensitive regex over symbol / raw NID / library; needed when imports exceed the breakpoint budget

elf_artifact.description: Artifact path of a decrypted ELF of this module (gives names when PT_SCE_DYNLIBDATA is not mapped in memory)

probe_at.description: plt (default): this module's PLT stub, catches only its calls; target: the GOT-bound function entry, catches every caller

dry_run.description: Only resolve and list the probes; never arms breakpoints or resumes

scan_limit_bytes.description: Bytes of executable memory the planning scan may read (default 64 MiB)

timeout_seconds.description: Wall-clock bound (default 30). On timeout the target is halted and every internal breakpoint cleared

max_events.description: Stop (target left halted) after this many recorded hits (default 1000)

max_breakpoints.description: Internal breakpoint budget (default 28; also bounded by free slots - user breakpoints are never touched)

capture_returns.description: Arm a temporary breakpoint at each call's return address to record rax and host-observed duration (uses budget slots)

string_bytes.description: Dereference pointer arguments inside readable maps as printable C strings up to this many bytes (0 = off)

thread_id.description: Record hits from this thread only (others are resumed and counted as filtered)

backtrace_frames.description: Per-hit stack unwind depth (0 = off; costly: several reads per hit)

name: debug_trace_syscalls
description: Trace syscalls made through libkernel*.sprx wrappers (mov rax,N; [mov r10,rcx;] syscall): scans the executable segments, derives numbers statically, names them (FreeBSD 9 natives, public Orbis dynlib_* additions, optional user dictionary; unknown -> sys_<n>), breakpoints the filtered wrappers and records number, name, args (rdi,rsi,rdx,r10,r8,r9), caller and thread. Bounded by timeout, max_events and the breakpoint budget; always halts and clears its breakpoints; JSONL artifact.

module.description: Module substring to scan instead of libkernel

dictionary_artifact.description: Artifact path of a JSON object {"<number>": "name"} overriding names

include_unrecognized.description: Also list/trace bare 0F 05 sites with no recognised wrapper (number from the event snapshot; may be false positives). Only applies without numbers/names filters

name: debug_trace_function
description: Trace calls to one or more functions (0x addresses, module+0xoffset, or debug_label names): entry args, caller (return address), stack usage, optional backtrace, hit counts, and with capture_returns the return value and host-observed duration. Bounded by timeout, max_events and the breakpoint budget; always halts and clears its breakpoints; JSONL artifact.

name: debug_coverage
description: Code coverage with one-shot breakpoints armed in rotating batches (at most max_breakpoints at once; each hit disarms its slot and arms the next block). Blocks come from a ps4wb-blocks-v1 artifact (RVAs rebased to the live module) or are derived live as function entries (.eh_frame FDEs, else push rbp; mov rbp,rsp prologues). Saves a ps4wb-coverage-v1 JSON artifact and a drcov v2 artifact for Lighthouse/Cartographer; reports covered/total. Always halts and clears its breakpoints.

module.description: Module (default: the blocks artifact's module, else eboot.bin)

blocks_artifact.description: Artifact path of a ps4wb-blocks-v1 document

source.description: Live block derivation when no blocks_artifact (default auto)

timeout_seconds.description: Wall-clock bound (default 30). On timeout the target is halted and every internal breakpoint cleared

max_events.description: Stop after this many block hits (default: all blocks)

max_breakpoints.description: Internal breakpoint budget (default 28; also bounded by free slots - user breakpoints are never touched)

dry_run.description: Only resolve and list the probes; never arms breakpoints or resumes

scan_limit_bytes.description: Bytes of executable memory the planning scan may read (default 64 MiB)

name: coverage_diff
description: Offline: compare two ps4wb-coverage-v1 artifacts by RVA and list covered blocks only in A, only in B, and in both (e.g. what ran when a button was pressed).
